conventions.device: x right, y top, z out of the screen; the rear camera looks along -z
conventions.earth: [E, N, U]; azimuth from north through east
conventions.gimbal: |alt| >= 89.99: roll 0, az = heading of the screen top (nadir) or heading + 180 (zenith)
conventions.roll: right-handed about the view axis, positive when the screen top leans to the user's right, (-180, 180]
conventions.screen_angle: screen.orientation.angle, counter-clockwise from natural; page = device turned back by it
